2607.09657.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
2607.09657.paper_summary: The rapid progress of large foundation models has been driven predominantly by pretraining on large-scale text corpora. However, many forms of knowledge are conveyed through visual representations, where figures, typeset equations, and page layouts carry rich information that cannot be faithfully or completely captured by text alone. Yet current pretraining approaches discard these visual cues by converting visually rich sources, such as documents and web pages, into plain text for learning language intelligence. This paper challenges the default assumption that language models must be trained on text-only representations and shows that Visual Pretraining is a scalable learner for foundation model intelligence. To this end, we conduct a systematic study of unsupervised visual pretraining paradigms that directly leverage visual documents without text extraction. Across multiple backbones and benchmarks, visual pretraining on the same underlying corpora consistently outperforms text-only pretraining, offering an efficient pathway to scalable language intelligence.
2607.09657.paper_summary_zh: 大型基礎模型的快速進展主要是通過在大規模文本語料庫上進行預訓練來驅動的。<lb/>然而，許多形式的知識是通過視覺表現來傳達的，其中圖形、排版方程式和頁面佈局承載著豐富的信息，這些信息無法僅通過文本忠實或完全捕捉。<lb/>然而，當前的預訓練方法通過將視覺豐富的來源（如文件和網頁）轉換為純文本來學習語言智能，從而忽略了這些視覺線索。<lb/>本文挑戰了語言模型必須僅在文本表示上進行訓練的默認假設，並顯示視覺預訓練是一種可擴展的基礎模型智能學習者。<lb/>為此，我們對無監督視覺預訓練範式進行了系統研究，這些範式直接利用視覺文件而不進行文本提取。<lb/>在多個骨幹和基準測試中，對相同底層語料庫的視覺預訓練始終優於僅基於文本的預訓練，提供了一條通往可擴展語言智能的高效途徑。
